privacy.subtitle: Our commitment to transparency in collecting, storing, and protecting user and Discord server data.
privacy.summary_item1: We collect minimal essential data required for bot operations (Server IDs, Channel IDs, Settings).
privacy.summary_item2: We NEVER sell, share, or monetize your data to any third party.
privacy.summary_item3: You have the right to request full data deletion for your user profile or server at any time.
privacy.s2_bullet1: Server Data: Server ID, Server Name, Channel IDs, Role IDs, and custom configurations (Welcome, AutoMod, Ticket, Leveling).
privacy.s2_bullet2: User Data: User ID, Username, Avatar URL, XP/Level statistics, AutoMod warning counts, and personal music playlists.
privacy.s2_bullet3: Audit Logs: Temporary message edit/delete logs (ONLY collected if the server admin enables the Logger module).
privacy.s2_note: ❌ WE DO NOT COLLECT: Private direct message (DM) content, personal passwords, payment information, or real-world identities.
privacy.s3_bullet1: Maintaining and storing server feature configurations.
privacy.s3_bullet2: Authenticating Web Dashboard sessions securely via Discord OAuth2.
privacy.s3_bullet3: Calculating XP levels, generating Rank Cards, and assigning reward roles automatically.
privacy.s3_bullet4: Enforcing server moderation tools (AutoMod, Warnings, Support Tickets).
privacy.s4_desc: Data is securely stored in a WAL-mode SQLite database on isolated infrastructure. Redis cache handles short-lived data securely. Strict access controls ensure raw database access is restricted exclusively to core bot systems.
privacy.s5_title: 5. User Rights & Data Deletion (Right to be Forgotten)
privacy.s5_desc: You have the right to inspect or delete data associated with your user account or server:
privacy.s5_bullet1: Server Data Deletion: Server owners may request complete database purging upon removing the bot from their server.
privacy.s5_bullet2: User Data Deletion: Users can request XP/Level resets or personal data deletion via our Discord Support Server Ticket Channel.
privacy.s6_desc: We PROUDLY GUARANTEE: We NEVER sell, rent, or trade user data to third parties or advertising networks. Data transfers occur strictly via encrypted HTTPS/WSS connections with official Discord APIs.
privacy.s7_desc: Zeryn Bot complies with Discord's age requirements (13+ or local legal minimum age). We do not knowingly collect data from children under legal age limits.
privacy.s8_desc: This policy may be updated periodically to reflect feature enhancements or legal requirements. Revision dates are publicly displayed. For privacy inquiries, please contact our team on the official Discord Support Server.

help.cat_ai_desc: Preguntas /ask, resúmenes /summarize y chat de IA
help.cat_ai_title: 🤖 Asistente de IA y Chatbot Inteligente
help.cat_ai_cmds:
**Models:** Groq LPU (Llama 3.3 70B / DeepSeek R1) & Google Gemini 2.0 Flash

• </ask:0> <question> — Ask smart questions, solve homework, write code, translate.
• </summarize:0> [limit] — Read and summarize recent chat history in the channel.
• Automated #ai-chat — Automatically converse when users talk in the designated AI channel.
• Owner Persona — Recognizes the bot owner (BOT_OWNER_ID) with respectful addressing.
help.cat_eco_desc: Monedas virtuales, tienda de roles y 8+ minijuegos
help.cat_eco_title: 💰 Sistema de Economía y Tienda de Roles
help.cat_eco_cmds:
**Currency:** Coins (🪙)

• </daily:0> — Claim daily coins with streak multiplier bonuses.
• </balance:0> [user] — Check wallet and bank balance for yourself or others.
• </pay:0> <user> <amount> — Securely transfer coins to another member.
• </rich:0> — Server wealth leaderboard.
• </coinflip:0> <bet> <heads/tails> — Double or nothing coin toss game.
• </slots:0> <bet> — Spin the lucky slot machine jackpot.
• </blackjack:0> <bet> — Interactive Blackjack card game with buttons.
• </shop:0> — Browse server role store with virtual coin prices.
• </buy:0> <item_id> — Purchase roles and get assigned instantly.
help.cat_voice_desc: Salas de voz privadas automáticas con panel de control
help.cat_voice_title: 🔊 Canales de Voz Temporales (Temp Voice Hub)
help.cat_voice_cmds:
**Mechanism:** Join the Hub channel to automatically spawn a private voice room.

• 🔒 Lock / 🔓 Unlock — Toggle open/private access to your voice room.
• ✏️ Rename — Customize room name via modal popups.
• 👥 User Limit — Set max participant capacity (1-99).
• 👑 Transfer Ownership — Hand over room ownership to a friend.
• 🚫 Kick User — Expel disruptive members from your voice room.
• ⚡ Auto Cleanup — Instant zero-resource cleanup when empty.
help.cat_level_desc: Progresión de XP en chat/voz con tarjetas de rango
help.cat_level_title: 🪪 Sistema de Niveles y Tarjetas de Rango
help.cat_level_cmds:
• </rank:0> [user] — View custom graphic Pillow Rank Card.
• </leaderboard:0> — Server XP leaderboard and top chatters.
• </xp add:0> <user> <xp> — Grant bonus XP to a member (Admin).
• </xp set:0> <user> <level> — Set user level directly (Admin).
• </xp reset:0> <user> — Reset user XP data (Admin).
• Role Rewards — Automatically unlock prestige roles at target levels.
help.cat_music_desc: Audio cristalino de YouTube y radio Lofi relajante
help.cat_music_title: 🎵 Reproductor de Música y Radio Lofi 24/7
help.cat_music_cmds:
• </play:0> <song/url> — Play audio from YouTube or Spotify.
• </lofi:0> — Stream relaxing 24/7 Lofi radio without interruption.
• </pause:0> & </resume:0> — Pause or resume playback.
• </skip:0> & </replay:0> — Skip song or replay from start.
• </stop:0> — Stop music, clear queue, and leave voice channel.
• </volume:0> <1-150> — Adjust playback volume.
• </queue:0> & </shuffle:0> — View and shuffle the music queue.
• </loop:0> [off/track/queue] — Loop single track or entire queue.
• </playlist:0> <save/load/delete> — Manage personal playlists.
help.cat_mod_desc: Protección 24/7, filtro de palabras y anti-spam
help.cat_mod_cmds:
• </automods show:0> — View current automod shield configuration.
• 24/7 Shield — Auto filters Spam, Bad words, Malicious links, Discord Invites, Capslock, Mass Mentions.
• </autorole:0> — Configure auto roles for newly joined members.
• </reactionroles:0> — Interactive role self-assignment panels.
• </config:0> — Overview of enabled modules and dashboard links.
• </sync:0> — Instantly synchronize bot slash commands.
help.cat_ticket_title: 🎫 Tickets de Soporte y Comandos Personalizados
help.cat_ticket_cmds:
• </ticket:0> — Create private ticket support panels for your community.
• </customcommands:0> — Manage custom trigger keywords.
• Dynamic Variables — Supports {user}, {mention}, {server}, {members}, {channel}, {random:min-max}.
• Transcript Logging — Automatically archive full ticket history upon close.
help.cat_giveaway_desc: Sorteos automáticos y selección de ganadores
help.cat_giveaway_cmds:
• </giveaway start:0> <duration> <winners> <prize> — Launch a giveaway.
• </giveaway end:0> <message_id> — End giveaway early and pick winners.
• </giveaway reroll:0> <message_id> — Roll new winners.
help.cat_util_desc: Ping, avatar, banner, estadísticas y encuestas
help.cat_util_cmds:
• </ping:0> — Check WebSocket and API roundtrip latency.
• </membercount:0> — Server member/bot demographics and online distribution.
• </serverinfo:0> — Detailed server metadata, security level, creation date.
• </userinfo:0> [user] — Account details, join date, and roles.
• </avatar:0> [user] — View full-resolution avatar.
• </botinfo:0> — Bot specs, RAM usage, CPU, and version info.
• </poll:0> <question> — Create quick reaction polls.
• </roll:0> [max] — Roll a random number between 1 and N.
• </choose:0> <opt1, opt2,...> — Pick a random option.
• </lang:0> <code_or_name> — Change bot language (i, en, zh, es, pt,  r).
